feeds.title: The Healthy Cooking Blog » Diabetic Recipes
feeds.description: You're guaranteed good food with a southern influence. If you're too busy to cook or just need cooking inspiration, you'll love these recipes for healthy cooking effortlessly with pantry-friendly ingredients and simple preparation.

feeds.title: Diabetes Diet
feeds.description: The Diabetes Diet explores what people affected with type one diabetes and type two diabetes, pre-diabetes and obesity need to do to get mastery over their blood sugar control, metabolism and weight. The scientific reasoning behind the low carbohydrate dietary approach is fully referenced and made easy by menu plans and low-carb recipes.

feeds.title: The Low Carb Diabetic
feeds.description: Promoting a low carb higher fat lifestyle for the safe control of weight and diabetes. The authors are all diabetics and believe in the low carb lifestyle, and minimal or no medication for the good control of diabetes.

feeds.title: Hangry Woman
feeds.description: I am Mila Clarke-Buckley, a food writer, author, stigma slayer, and more. Living with diabetes sucks. So let's talk about food, self-care, and diabetes topics that sometimes feel like they're off-limits. This is an open and safe space for you.

feeds.title: Diabetic Foodie Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Shelby, aka Diabetic Foodie. If you have diabetes, cook for someone who has diabetes or just want to eat healthily, you're in the right place.

feeds.title: Whole Hearty Kitchen
feeds.description: Easy, Nourishing, Healthy recipes that support your diabetes management and help balance blood glucose. Along with a few of the things I have learnt as a parent to a type 1 teenager as well! This blog is about sharing great but yet simple recipes, tips and the odd ramblings from a parent to a type 1 teenager. The overall aim of the food I share here is to offer no-frills, convenient and sometimes alternative options to support and help balance blood glucose management.

feeds.title: Milk & Honey Nutrition
feeds.description: Diabetes education doesn't have to be stressful. Explore my diabetes blog for insights about living with diabetes, the best foods for diabetes, and health tips.

feeds.title: Eating Well » Diabetes Diet Center
feeds.description: Learn about a diabetes diet and healthy lifestyle with articles, meal plans and recipes from EatingWell's food and nutrition experts.

feeds.title: My Diabetes Care Community
feeds.description: Simplify diabetes meal planning with low-glycemic, delicious recipes crafted by professional dietitians to manage blood sugar effectively.

feeds.title: Diabetes Coalition of York County » Food
feeds.description: The Food section on Diabetes York offers practical tips and recipes for healthy eating to help manage diabetes, including food recommendations and dining out strategies.

feeds.title: Diabetes Telecare Blog
feeds.description: The Diabetes Telecare Blog offers expert insights on managing diabetes through telemedicine, covering topics like nutrition, exercise, mental health, and seasonal care.

feeds.title: Low Carb Maven
feeds.description: Hii! I'm Kim. I share healthy low carb, ketogenic recipes to help you reach your fitness, health, or dinner goals. Most recipes are diabetic friendly and all are family approved.

feeds.title: For Good Measure
feeds.description: Covers low-carb diabetic recipes for breakfast, sides, snacks and more. For Good Measure blog is about blending diabetes with culinary inspiration.

feeds.title: Natasha's Food Adventures
feeds.description: Natasha's food adventures features wholesome, healthy and balanced recipes the whole family will love. Food blog by Natasha Octon, who pours her heart into reimaging healthy diabetic friendly recipes that are fresh, easy, and fun for the whole family.

feeds.title: Diabetes Strong
feeds.description: Diabetes Strong is dedicated to inspiring people with diabetes and giving them the tools to live an active and healthy lifestyle.
